title: Prove that subprocess unwind fixture child modes actually execute
outcome: Exit-only subprocess regression checks cannot pass when their child selector or mode environment skips the intended fixture body.
acceptance: The native phase gate unwind parent test observes an execution witness for each cancel, worker, driver and both child mode; a missing mode or an unmatched exact selector cannot pass as exercised coverage.
Existing CapturedStderrProcess callers with the same exit-only pattern, starting with federation_shutdown_unwind.rs, are assessed and tightened where the child body could silently be skipped.
Checks exercise observable child execution without Markdown phrase tests, real timeout-expiry waits, weakened assertions or inflated limits.
